string.text: Report scope of skill and character XP messages. Player only: your own gains. Party only: companions and clan members. Player and party: both. All: also allied lords and helped neutrals. Default: Player and party.
Merge gains of the same hero and skill within this interval into one message.
Show remaining XP to the next skill level, e.g. +10(990).
Show remaining XP to the next level, e.g. +300(4500).
Show total skill and character XP gained per hero during the current battle. Default: on.
Opacity of the battle XP table. Default: 80.
Font size of the table, kept small to avoid blocking the view. Default: 16.
Horizontal offset of the table. Default: 400.
Vertical offset of the table. Default: 100.
Include party members in the table; off shows the player only. Default: on.
Include allied heroes (lords of your faction or helped neutrals) in the table. Default: off.
Show the hero's current health after the name, e.g. XXX(100/300). Default: on.
Show total damage dealt this battle after the name. Default: on.
Width of the table; long lines wrap only when exceeding this. Default: 1200.
Maximum number of hero rows shown; extra rows are hidden. Default: 10.
Sort rows by total damage dealt (highest first). Default: off.
Always keep the player's row first (takes priority over sorting). Default: on.
Output battle table debug info (row order) to the game log.
